BEHAVIOR: - Trim the input value. If the trimmed value is empty, add nothing and keep the input focused. - On a successful add, clear the input. - Render all task text only through textContent or aria-label set with setAttribute. Never use innerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML or document.write with user data. Text like x or & must appear literally. - The checkbox change event toggles completed in both directions. - Filtering must be exact. all shows every task, active shows completed=false, completed shows completed=true. Re-render the list by removing non-matching items from the DOM. - Store tasks as a JSON array of {id, text, completed} in localStorage under a single key such as "awe-task-tracker.v1". - Generate ids with an incrementing counter or Date.now plus a counter. Do not use crypto APIs that may be unavailable. - Save after every add, toggle and delete. - On load, wrap JSON.parse and storage access in try/catch, and drop malformed entries without throwing. - Delete removes only the task with the matching id. Duplicate task texts must stay independent. - Text, completion and deletions must survive a page reload. ACCESSIBILITY AND LAYOUT: - Use native, visible, keyboard-operable controls only. Do not hide labels or controls with display:none, and do not use tabindex hacks. - Keep visible focus outlines. - Use box-sizing:border-box globally and a max-width container with width:100%. - Let the form and list rows wrap with flex-wrap. - Apply overflow-wrap:anywhere and word-break:break-word on task text, so long unbroken strings cause no horizontal overflow at 375px or 1280px. - Do not use fixed widths larger than the viewport.
